structure.unit: Waters of the State, Ports and Harbors

text.section:
A person may use, sell, manufacture, or distribute for use or sale, a cleaning agent that contains greater than zero percent phosphorus by weight but does not exceed 8.7 percent phosphorus by weight that is:
A detergent used in a commercial dishwashing machine; and
A substance excluded from the zero percent phosphorus limitation of this chapter by regulations adopted by the Board of Agriculture and Consumer Services which are based on a finding that compliance with this chapter would: a. Create a significant hardship on the user; or b. Be unreasonable because of the lack of an adequate substitute cleaning agent.
